game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Mine Cart Tunnel Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the torchbearer ahead. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the mine cart by solving code steps involving belt_count that move the torchbearer forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the mine cart first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Loop Counter Conveyor' (Week 4 slot 9), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Mine Cart Tunnel'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how belt_count changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
